bibdata.title: Jitter measuring equipment for digital systems which are based on the optical transport network
Jitter measuring equipment for digital systems which are based on the optical transport network
bibdata.abstract: Recommendation ITU-T O.173 specifies instrumentation that is used to generate and measure jitter in digital systems based on the optical transport network (OTN). Measurement requirements for client interfaces, e.g., SDH line interfaces are not addressed in this Recommendation.The requirements for the characteristics of the jitter measuring equipment that are specified in this Recommendation must be adhered to in order to ensure consistency of results between equipment produced by different manufacturers.
